title: 4⁴
blurb: Guided respiration timer based on the 4-4-4-4 box breathing technique; visual and haptic cues for inhale, hold, exhale, hold cycles.
description: 4⁴ is a local-first guided breathing clock centered on the canonical four-phase box-breathing protocol. The web edition provides synchronized visual guidance, high-resolution timing, audio cues, optional haptics, optional spoken prompts, fullscreen mode, wake lock support, persistent settings, session statistics, and JSON export.
author: [0xdeadbeef] of ZZX-Labs R&D

capabilities.name: 4-phase box breathing timer
capabilities.notes: Uses performance.now() and requestAnimationFrame for synchronized display.
